rrss-app/src/chat.rs: Digest conversation context fragments sent to Pi.
rrss-app/src/jobs/summaries.rs: Chunked full-text summary input and note headings sent to the model.
rrss-app/src/pi/workspace.rs: Managed system-prompt suffix addressed to Pi.
rrss-core/src/ai_store.rs: Built-in model prompt templates and their internal template titles.
rrss-core/src/cite.rs: Citation context and instruction fragments sent to the model, not UI notices.
rrss-core/src/cluster_summary.rs: Numbered reporting input and instructions for model summaries.
rrss-core/src/db/migrations.rs: Migration SQL that matches titles written by older versions.
rrss-core/src/digest.rs: Digest model-input prompts, date headings inside model input, and Chinese model-output parsing patterns.
rrss-core/src/digest_sources.rs: Fallback heading inside the generated digest document; follows the AI output language.
rrss-core/src/memories.rs: Confirmed-memory prefix injected into the Pi system prompt (model input).
rrss-core/src/pi_store.rs: RRSS tool descriptions and parameter hints addressed to Pi; UI names are localized by tool name.
rrss-core/src/rag.rs: Retrieval context and instruction suffix sent to Pi.
rrss-core/src/rank/features.rs: Chinese stop words used by title-token feature extraction.
rrss-core/src/simhash.rs: Chinese stop words used by near-duplicate hashing.
rrss-core/src/summary_extract.rs: Model-input link-stub instructions and content-extraction markers.
rrss-core/src/vector_space.rs: Fixed probe sentences embedded to detect vector-space drift (model input).
rrss-render/src/legacy.rs: Matches placeholder text that older versions stored in cached documents; never produced.
